column9: Strong local Houston leadership fit on merits: director-level educational technology role at UTHealth Houston School of Dentistry involving LMS/e-learning platforms, curriculum partnership, faculty support, project/portfolio management, standards, accessibility/interoperability, people leadership, budget/resource planning, and healthcare education. Main cautions: on-site, no posted compensation, security-sensitive/critical-infrastructure review language, physical requirements, and broader budget/internal controls ownership. Recommend shortlist/review if compensation is viable and on-site Houston is acceptable.
